policy.direct_local_evidence: An exact or defensible Nigerian role/subgroup profile match with item-level provenance.
policy.domain_context: Separate Nigerian sector or domain evidence that can guide a role without claiming the item is role-specific.
policy.no_direct: No exact match in the checked Nigerian profiles; never an absence claim. The row retains global evidence and domain context where available.
policy.sql: Do not regenerate SQL while exhaustive_search_declaration is false, even when the integrity gate passes.
